data.title: DCC Energy shareholders back takeover by Dragon Bidco
data.description:
An announcement from DCC plc ( (GB:DCC) ) is now available.

Shareholders of DCC Energy plc have approved a recommended acquisition by Dragon Bidco Limited, a newly formed vehicle indirectly owned by funds advised by Energy Capital Partners and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts. At a scheme meeting and extraordinary general meeting, more than three-quarters of votes cast supported the scheme of arrangement and associated corporate resolutions, clearing a key hurdle for the takeover.

The board said the transaction offers shareholders an opportunity to crystallise value, with completion still contingent on remaining conditions, including sanction of the scheme and related capital reduction by the Irish High Court. The deal, expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, positions DCC Energy for private ownership under infrastructure-focused investors, potentially reshaping its capital structure and strategic direction for existing stakeholders.

data.title: La Forestière Équatoriale Profit Slips as Lower Rates Weigh on Financial Income
data.description:
La Forestiere Equatoriale SA ( (FR:FORE) ) has issued an update.

La Forestière Équatoriale reported a first-half 2026 net profit of 329 million CFA francs, down from 359 million CFA francs a year earlier, as lower interest income from its cash management agreement offset a slight improvement in operating losses. The operating result improved marginally to a loss of 74 million CFA francs, while the company maintained robust shareholders’ equity of about 14.2 billion CFA francs and a significant net cash position, highlighting continued financial solidity despite a softer interest-rate environment.

The financial result declined to 440 million CFA francs from 478 million CFA francs in the prior-year period, reflecting the impact of falling interest rates on returns from cash investments. The Board approved the half-year financial statements prepared under revised OHADA standards, and the completion of limited review procedures on these statements supports the reliability of the reported figures for investors and other stakeholders.
